notes:
v4.6.19 — Crypto bot reads its assigned universe + universe file ships to cloud

🐛 FIXED
• Crypto trading bot hardcoded ['BTC-USD','ETH-USD','LTC-USD'] in its symbols list and never read the universe file the user assigned via the bot-tab dropdown. Now it calls load_universe() at start AND at the top of every cycle so the assigned universe takes effect immediately + universe-script updates apply without a bot restart.
• Cloud-running trading bots couldn't read the user's universe file because that file lives on the user's LAPTOP (universe scripts run locally). New /bots/private/upload_universe endpoint accepts a universe .txt blob and writes it to the user's data dir on Oracle. BotProcessWidget._cloud_start now uploads the assigned universe BEFORE the bot script, so the cloud bot sees the latest tickers on first cycle.
• Bot reload loop: load_universe runs at every cycle, not just startup. Universe updates from a freshly-run universe script take effect on the trading bot's next 5-minute tick without a restart.

The crypto.py bundled on Oracle has been updated to the new template — restart the cloud crypto bot to pick it up.
